character_description: Medusa, transformed being with serpentine hair that writhes with consciousness, golden eyes that once destroyed now hold compassion, bronze skin bearing marks of curse-transformation. Not monster but survivor—her appearance reflects what was done to her, not what she is.
setting: Sacred temple, Underworld sanctuary, and eventually reclaimed empowerment spaces
theme: Transforming victimization into sovereignty and refusing to accept others' narratives of monstrosity

video_prompts: Medusa in Athena's temple before violation, young priestess with normal appearance and pure heart dedicated to service.
first_frame_prompt: Young Medusa tends Athena's temple with devotion, her dark hair flowing beautifully, golden eyes reflecting genuine faith. She embodies priestess virtue—devoted, pure, hopeful. The temple radiates peace around her. She does not know that violation approaches under guise of divine right, that her trust will become weaponized.
speech: I serve Athena with my whole heart. I am honored to be her priestess.
